name: @zendev-lab/spark
description: Spark monorepo: daemon-first agent orchestration across CLI, local web, Hub, and channels, with Pi retained only as an SDK kernel.
author: zrr1999

scripts.check: pnpm run check:static && pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:process:source
scripts.check:static: pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-hub exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-web exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-docs exec astro sync && node scripts/sync-workspace-versions.mjs && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && pnpm exec prek run actionlint --all-files && pnpm exec prek run zizmor --all-files && pnpm run check:agent-knowledge && pnpm run check:cue-skill && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run check:tool-surface && pnpm run check:boundaries && vp fmt . --check && vp lint --quiet --report-unused-disable-directives-severity error && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.check:architecture: pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-web-dsh run build && prek run check-jsonschema check-metaschema --files architecture/packages.json architecture/packages.schema.json architecture/health.schema.json && syncpack lint --config .syncpackrc.json --no-ansi && knip --strict --include unlisted --no-progress --no-config-hints && node scripts/check-architecture-ratchets.mjs && node scripts/check-architecture-governance.mjs --check
scripts.fix: pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-hub exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-web exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-docs exec astro sync && vp fmt . --write && vp lint --fix --quiet && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-hub run check && pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-web run check && vp check --no-fmt --no-lint && pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-daemon run check
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-hub exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-web exec svelte-kit sync && vp test run --config vitest.root.config.ts && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present run test
scripts.test:process:source: pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-hub run build && vp test run --config vitest.process.config.ts
scripts.test:journey:repro: pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-hub run build && vp test run --config vitest.journey.config.ts
scripts.test:browser: pnpm run test:browser:hub && pnpm run test:browser:ui && pnpm run test:browser:web
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-daemon run build && pnpm --filter @zendev-lab/spark-hub run build

nMinusOneMigrationExemptions.0.4.0: One-time coordinated hard cut for view-model protocol v2; mixed 0.3.x and 0.4.0 processes are unsupported.
nMinusOneMigrationExemptions.0.5.0: Native deployment generation v2 requires an explicit backed-up managed reinstall; the 0.4 updater must not activate it.
